cited_by.title: Skin cancer and moles on dark skin

record.population: Black and non-Hispanic White patients with melanoma, SEER 2006-2015
record.finding: Five-year melanoma-specific survival was 66.9% in Black patients against 84.3% in non-Hispanic White patients; Black patients had thicker, more ulcerated tumours and acral melanoma was 32.6% of Black cases.
record.note: From the research file; author list not re-checked.
